acceptance: A unit test reproduces the #4013 shape: a claimed prior D1 from the local record, an owner WITHDRAW D1 comment, and a fresh gate evaluation that no longer lists D1 as open; the same comment from a non-owner leaves it open.
A test shows that an adjudication that cannot apply (unknown id, or a finding that is not open) yields a visible reason naming the comment and why it did not apply.
Existing adjudication tests for escalated ordinary findings pass unchanged.
docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md states that owner adjudication covers claimed priors, and how an unusable adjudication is reported.
The PR is merged with required checks green.
description:
Gap seen on PR #4013 (tracker runtime move to tractable 1.0.0), 2026-11-07. The hosted verdict on head aaa8ead was SHIP WITH FIXES and carried "D1 (claimed Medium)" as still open: "Modified test fakes the upstream release download by patching urllib.request.urlopen", in tests/unit/scripts/test_comment_policy.py, test test_verify_upstream_release_validates_real_github_asset. D1 came from the local make pr-open findings record, written into the PR body as the review-local-record marker and replayed by CI as a claimed prior (docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md, sections "Findings record and local disputes" and "Findings record in the PR body"). By then the PR no longer modified that file, and the patching was pre-existing on develop.

The owner decided WITHDRAW D1 and posted `Review adjudication: WITHDRAW D1 - ...`. It had no effect: oracle-gate stayed failure for about 30 minutes, and make pr-arm refused because the latest verdict listed open findings "which a stand-in cannot waive". Owner adjudication applies only to escalated findings (open after two dispute rounds), and a dispute needs a Dispute: reply on a thread with the finding marker, which a claimed prior does not have. The only way through was changing the test (commit ba696ea).

Decision (owner, 2026-11-14):
- An owner `Review adjudication: WITHDRAW|MAINTAIN D<n> - <instruction>` comment also applies to a finding carried as a claimed prior from the local record, without needing escalation.
- An adjudication comment that cannot apply (unknown id, finding not open, wrong head, not from the owner) produces a visible reason in the gate result instead of being ignored.

Guardrails:
- Only the repository owner's comment counts, as today. Agents never post adjudications on their own initiative, only when the owner names the PR, head, finding and decision.
- The record's claims still never close a finding or count as a strike on their own; a forged or edited local record can only create work.
- Escalation, strike and dispute-round rules for ordinary findings are unchanged.
- MAINTAIN on a claimed finding keeps it open.
